decisions.reason: As a flagship waterproof line close to the core offer, it costs little to keep, and no evidence since 2019 shows its value has failed, so the option stays open.

ESD occupational shoes are a standard, low-cost addition to a broad range, and with no adverse signal reported, keeping the option is cheaper than abandoning it, though single models are rotated more readily.
This multi-model safety series sits in the firm's core business with low holding cost, and without evidence of failure the firm would keep it while its market results continue to come in.
